name: Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip
definition: Abnormal development and stability of the hip joint in infancy or childhood, ranging from acetabular dysplasia to subluxation or dislocation.

investigations.MRI: Ultrasound is preferred in young infants before ossification; MRI is selective.
investigations.radiographs: AP pelvis radiographs are used later in infancy/childhood.

amber: Treatment timing matters; delayed diagnosis increases likelihood of operative intervention.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhi-vikriti/developmental phenotype may be documented, but modern pediatric hip diagnosis remains primary.

patientEducation.summary: Abnormal development and stability of the hip joint in infancy or childhood, ranging from acetabular dysplasia to subluxation or dislocation.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Detection and Nonoperative Management of Pediatric DDH
